name: code-factory
description: Design-first autonomous code factory: interviews you for decisions, then implements the todo list branch by branch and PR by PR until CI-green merges, with git/gh gates the model cannot skip.

interface.shortDescription: Design once, then build every todo item PR by PR until CI-green merges.
interface.longDescription: Type $factory-design to be interviewed for the design, $factory-approve to approve it and start the loop. The factory hands Codex one item at a time and its hooks refuse pushes to the base branch, PRs without tests or a clean independent review, and merges before CI is green.
